description.value: Black Rabbit Kitchen occupies a beautifully restored historic train station in Nanaimo's Old City Quarter, serving seasonal shared plates made entirely from scratch — including the bread, mayo, and sauces — with a focus on local ingredients and whole-animal butchery. Opened in 2022, it anchors a multi-concept building that also houses White Rabbit Coffee Co., The General Store, and The Attic private dining room. A touring cyclist can move from a morning coffee and gluten-free baked good to a full shared-plate lunch or dinner without leaving the complex.

address.value: 321 Selby Street, Old City Quarter, Nanaimo, BC

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is rich and current (©2026). The address on the website consistently states '321 Selby Street' while OSM records '321 Wesley Street' — a clear discrepancy flagged below. Wi-Fi and device charging are confirmed for the adjacent White Rabbit Coffee Co. space (same building, same team); GF/vegan baked goods are confirmed at the coffee shop side, and the restaurant menu pages note dietary accommodation. No explicit mention of bike parking, washrooms, water refill, or takeout for the kitchen side.
concerns: Address mismatch: OSM records '321 Wesley Street' but the website consistently states '321 Selby Street, Old City Quarter, Nanaimo, BC'. The website value has been used; OSM address should be corrected.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active, open restaurant in a notable restored train station building in Nanaimo — a real, publicly accessible business with a current website.
enrichment_extras.notes: White Rabbit Coffee Co. is a separate named concept in the same building (open daily); its amenities (Wi-Fi, device charging, GF/vegan food, patio) are accessible to cyclists visiting the complex. The Attic upstairs private dining is explicitly not wheelchair accessible (20 steps, no lift); the main Black Rabbit and White Rabbit spaces are noted as fully accessible with ramps at front and back entrances.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: White Rabbit Coffee Co. (same building, same kitchen team) confirms baked goods are gluten-free and vegan as standard. Restaurant menu pages note dietary restrictions can be flagged at reservation for best accommodation

Device charging.detail: White Rabbit Coffee Co. (adjoining space, same building) has 'dedicated workstations with plugs built specifically for solo visitors and laptop workers.'
